_about: Words that name a kind of document, a trade or a filler on a data sheet heading and never a piece of equipment (order 206.1, #1281). `submittal_fill.equipment_name` drops them from a heading before it reads the equipment; when nothing is left it takes the object after FOR; when still nothing, no equipment type is written (no type is better than a wrong one). Disciplines (mechanical, process, ...) come from `classification._DISCIPLINE_LABELS`. Generic words only, never one sheet's wording. Edit here, not in code. `whole_names` are names that are filler only when they are the WHOLE name ("MATERIAL SAFETY DATA SHEET"), not inside one ("PRESSURE SAFETY VALVES").
